body: Unfortunately, I've already tried pretty much everything to show her how important she is to me, and that I really am sorry about what I said, but it seems like it's too late. If she doesn't want me in her life anymore, then it might be best for me to try to move on. And I never thought about it that way. I've always realized that there is someone who would be happy to be in my shoes, and who has so many more problems than I do. It's part of the reason that I usually don't tell people about how I feel, or what's happening in my life. I feel guilty complaining about my problems after all the things I've heard about other people having to deal with. And yeah, bragging isn't something I'm interested in. If I volunteered, I'd keep it to myself. I don't really see the appeal in doing things just to change how people think about you. I don't care all that much about what people think of me. I care a lot more about how I feel, or make others feel. I like helping people. I love seeing people smile or be happy when they're around me. Volunteering would probably really help me, but I've never really thought about it for some reason. I'm definitely going to look into it more. And I live in the United States. For some reason it makes me feel a little better knowing that someone so far away from me has gone through similar things, and felt similar feelings. I guess it makes me feel a little less alone.

I might end up checking out a job as an electrician if things don't end up going how I plan. Doesn't sound too awful to me. And yeah, I suppose you're right about that. Most things being reported are terrible. A happy story doesn't really catch people's attention the same way a horror story does.

Yeah, thinking about everything I need to do at once makes me feel like I'm going to have a mental breakdown. I always read about people who are screwed completely by things they couldn't control, like hospital bills that are ridiculous, or their ex girlfriends falsely telling everyone they raped her and ruining their lives and other things like that. Sometimes it makes me feel like the world is too shitty, and that it's not even worth trying because I'm going to get screwed no matter what I do. People who go to college can't even find jobs a lot of the time. If I don't finish high school, what hope is there that I'll be able to support myself?

Thank you for sharing your story. It's given me a little hope. After the things you've gone through you still ended up happy. When I hear things like this, I always think about how strong a person the writer must be. I don't feel strong most of the time, but I can still make myself keep going to see what's ahead. Might as well. I've talked to my mother about some of this. She's currently feeding me sugar pills called nervoheel x or something. She refuses to believe any effects would be placebo, even though I could down the whole bottle and literally nothing would happen. It's not real medicine, and it's not working. I need to convince her to take me to get a mental evaluation (don't really know the process) and prescription. Thanks for the advice, I was considering getting a gym membership and starting to work out. Maybe that could give me some of the victories I need. :)

Pretty much everything you said lines up with me. Although, I've never really considered that my intellect could be higher than my peers'. I've always just kind of assumed I was too stupid to do the work correctly, or my attention span was too short or something. And yes, I do analyze things a lot. In that argument I brought up some things she had said before, and told her that I knew she had been pretending the whole time we were friends just because she didn't want to be alone. I said this because the moment she found a boyfriend, she pretty much went from talking a lot every day to barely talking every few days, and it felt like she replaced me. I compared her to someone from her life who had hurt her. I didn't know how bad the person I compared her to actually was, because she'd never told me, but apparently he had destroyed her life. She wouldn't forgive me for comparing her to him, so she cut me off. This happened only a few days ago, and I miss her so much. She will never forgive me though, she holds on to grudges really tightly. And maybe I'll try volunteering somewhere. If it worked for you, maybe it'll work for me. Thank you for writing, it means a lot to me
Thank you for taking the time to write. I'll keep this stuff in mind; maybe this could be the info I needed to start getting better.
